Subject: Handoff: BrightBridge model shortlist & capacity estimates

Monica —

Looping you in to start the implementation sizing for BrightBridge Health (BBH). Sales has agreed to move forward pending technical kickoff; we need a short, pragmatic model shortlist and token-volume sizing to help operations decide hosted vs Dedicated. Quick summary:

- Account: BrightBridge Health (HIPAA scope)
- Current ask: chat + summarization + document retrieval in clinical workflows
- Preference: hosted initially, but they asked for Dedicated pricing if capacity/PII concerns arise
- Sales ask: recommend 2–3 model variants (low-cost / mid / high-quality) with context-length guidance and a conservative tokens/day estimate for first 90 days

I've attached a draft onboarding plan and the initial token-estimates spreadsheet the AE filled from discovery. Please review and propose:
1) Shortlist (model names + why)
2) Recommended max context length per workflow and fallback plan
3) Token/day and peak RPS assumptions used for sizing (conservative & optimistic)
4) Any infra flags (VPC, KMS, HIPAA-specific notes) we should raise to security/ops now

Goal: ship a 1-pager for the CS/ops kickoff and a proposed agenda for the technical workshop by EOD today so Marissa can confirm the kickoff slot with the customer.

Thanks —
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — taking this on. Quick clarifying Qs before I finalize the 1-pager:

- Are the ’chat’ and ’summarize’ workflows synchronous (user waits) vs async batch (background job)? That materially changes latency targets and batching recommendations.
- Do we have representative prompt lengths or a redacted prompt sample? The AE attached an average tokens/session but not a prompt breakdown.
- Confirm whether any of the source docs are >100k chars (long-form ingestion) — affects retrieval chunking and context window strategy.

Initial topology idea (high level):
- Low-cost: Mistral-7B-Instruct quantized (good for short chats, ~2–4 token/compute cost)
- Mid: Llama2-13B-Chat int8 (better instruction-following for clinical QA)
- High-quality / long-context: Redwood-RT-70B / 8k context variant for longer summaries / batch jobs

I’ll map those models to workflows once Anna confirms sync vs async and share token/day conservative vs 95th percentile traffic. Tentative: conservative estimate 2.5M tokens/day, optimistic 6M tokens/day based on AE numbers.

Will circulate a 1-pager + MC agenda by 3pm PT.

— Monica

Thanks Karthik & team — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few data points from our side to help you size:

- Workflows: synchronous chat for clinicians (avg session: clinician asks 3–5 questions; average model tokens per session ~1,500 including prompt + response) and nightly ingestion batch for summarization/reporting (we ingest ~120k pages/day, expect chunking into ~2.2M document chunks across the day).
- Expected baseline traffic: roughly 100 concurrent clinician sessions during peak hours (9–17 ET) — peak RPS estimate ~25–40 requests/sec depending on UI batching.
- Tokens: our internal estimate ~3.0M tokens/day initially (first 30 days) with growth to ~8M/day over 90 days as adoption increases.
- Latency: clinicians need sub-700ms 95th percentile for short QA; longer summaries can be async.
- Compliance: we are HIPAA-bound; we prefer hosted SaaS but will evaluate Dedicated or Private if audit log retention / VPC/KMS needs require it. Please assume PHI in payloads.

Happy to join a sizing workshop — Marissa, Monica, what times do you have next week?

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Clinical Platforms, BrightBridge Health
anna@brightbridgehealth.com
+1 617-555-0184

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Handoff: BrightBridge model shortlist & capacity estimates

Anna — thanks, this is very helpful. Based on the details you provided I sketched a practical sizing + shortlist. Key outputs below (I'll finalize numbers into the spreadsheet and 1-pager):

1) Shortlist mapped to workflows
- Clinician real-time QA (short prompts, need low latency): Mistral-7B-Instruct (quantized) as the cost-efficient baseline; Llama2-13B-Chat int8 as the recommended balanced option for medical QA; Redwood-RT-70B-8k for fallbacks where higher fidelity is required.

2) Context length guidance
- Short QA: keep prompts + retrieved context <= 2,048 tokens to keep 95p under 700ms on hosted with batching. Use prefix caching for repeated system tokens.
- Long summary / batch: 8k context on dedicated or 8k/32k quantized models depending on chunking strategy; run as async jobs to avoid clinician latency impact.

3) Token volume estimates (draft)
- Conservative (month 0–1): 3.0M tokens/day -> ~90M tokens/month
- Growth (month 1–3): up to 8.0M tokens/day -> ~240M tokens/month
- Peak RPS: plan for burst capacity to sustain 40 RPS with an autoscale buffer (headroom 1.5x) — recommend Dedicated or reserved burst if costs matter.

4) Cost/ops flags
- Hosted per-token pricing likely fine for month 0–1; for sustained 100s of concurrent sessions and 8M tokens/day we should price out Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Security: treat as PHI — require KMS integration + audit-log retention. Ops will need a SOC2/HIPAA checklist before access.

Next steps: I’ll attach the updated token_estimates_BBH.xlsx and a one-page model-shortlist + capacity summary for the technical kickoff. Propose technical kickoff: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 10:00–11:00 PT (or Tues 30th same window) — please confirm availability.

— Monica
